svg.desc: Lycee Francais du Caire LOCATION Maadi, Egypt CLIENT Ministry of French Education STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 110 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Currently in progress, this 12,500 m2 project in Maadi upgrades the Lycee Francais du Caire (LFC) to create a high-quality, engaging educational environment that enriches student life. Services include architecture, landscape, interior design, environmental consulting, structural and MEP works, along with full project management and site supervision. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
